input.quote: This Agreement (including the Exhibits attached hereto), together with the pharmacovigilance agreement specified in Section 4.11(b), the Quality Agreement, and the Supply Agreement (in each case, when executed) constitute the entire agreement between the Parties relating to the subject matter hereof and supersede all prior and contemporaneous agreements, representations and/or understandings, including the Confidentiality Agreement between the Parties dated August 26, 2016.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the agreement. Text searches for solicit, employ or engage, hire, recruit and induce returned no restrictive covenant on personnel, and the covenants provisions and the full General Provisions block (Sections 18.1-18.14) contain none. The integration clause confirms no prior agreement, including the 2016 Confidentiality Agreement, survives to import one. Ono is bound by no employee non-solicit, which is the playbook preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
